definitions.tokens: Exact code/input CSV fields using encode_ordinary; full supplied code including helpers and comments, no prompt or reference. Fixed reference encoding, not provider-specific token usage.
definitions.executable_lines: Physical code-token lines including headers/continuations; exclude blank/comment lines and standalone literal strings (docstrings). Exclude RE2 helper labels: dotted names (also dot-prefixed or with a hyphenated package) before definitions, and frame names such as pkg.mod.<genexpr>. No execution.
definitions.cyclomatic_complexity: 1 + decision points of the whole supplied code (helper labels excluded): if/elif, conditional expressions, for/while loops, comprehension for-clauses and conditions, each and/or, except clauses, match cases. No execution.
definitions.target_cyclomatic_complexity: The same for the target alone: the entry-point function (complexity_target names it; when several functions share the name, the one defined in a class), or the whole script when there is no entry point.
definitions.halstead: From Python tokens of the whole code (helper labels excluded): operators are operator/punctuation tokens and keywords; operands are names, numbers, strings and f-string text (a docstring is one operand); layout and comments are skipped. Volume = (operators + operands) * log2(distinct operators + distinct operands); difficulty = distinct operators / 2 * operands / distinct operands. target_halstead_* use the tokens on the target's lines.
definitions.information_flow: Henry-Kafura information flow of the target without the length term (as IF4): (fan-in * fan-out)^2. Fan-in: parameters other than self, names read from outside the target, instance attributes read. Fan-out: distinct functions called (methods by name), instance attributes written. Calls into the target are not in the supplied code, so fan-in counts data only.
definitions.missing: Blank executable_lines means tokenization failed, not zero. lexical_only means tokenization succeeded but AST parsing failed; source-size count only, and no complexity or Halstead measures. Blank target measures with a parsed program mean the target could not be told apart.
